scope: Only the opening communication paragraph; response-only experiment, not skill routing or tool-workflow performance.

generator.temperature: provider default; CLI has no temperature option

judge.limitation: Separate context and model ID, same provider/model family; author audits quotes and content. Not independent human evaluation.

selection: Prefer direct over example unless examples show a clear incremental benefit. Candidate must reduce evidenced unwanted style without losing required content or introducing critical failures. Ties retain the installed baseline; differences are descriptive, not statistical superiority.
holdout_policy: Freeze both candidates and all cases before generation. Choose one candidate from development only; write selection.json before holdout calls. No source dossier or topic family crosses splits. Original conversation IDs are unavailable, so distinct original sessions are not claimed.
privacy: Cases are independently written, de-identified reconstructions or synthetic tasks, not quotations or replay. No private documents, personal names, progress records, or source paths are sent to models or committed.
reporting: Preserve every attempt; no quality-based retries. Failures and malformed judgments remain visible. Report long and short separately, missing content, critical failures, style rates/regions, clarity, visible characters, usage and duration. No hidden reasoning is saved or scored.
rollout: Only replace the installed-template source after positive holdout evidence and author review; otherwise retain baseline and publish bounded results. Do not change live HOME instructions.
